sources: dossier=silent on the canonical name for the commit/abandon/release verb family; corroborated across independent artifacts=claim-producer.md:39 and auto-terminal.md:35 both use 'terminal verbs' (majority idiom across the two docs most load-bearing for the mechanism), while claim.md:27 used 'post-terminal verb' and claim-handle.md:39 uses 'claim-disposition verb'; breakpoint.md:11 independently uses 'post-terminal' for an unrelated checkpoint-position concept, so claim.md's term collided with an unrelated noun regardless of which name is chosen as canonical.
note: Three names for one verb family across adjacent docs is a Plumbline uniformity violation, and claim.md's specific term additionally collided with breakpoint.md's unrelated 'post-terminal' checkpoint position. Renamed claim.md's Boundaries-section term from 'post-terminal verb' to 'terminal verb', aligning with the majority idiom in claim-producer.md and auto-terminal.md. claim-handle.md's 'claim-disposition verb' remains inconsistent and needs the same alignment, but is out of scope for this edit (not claim.md) — queued for a follow-up fix-doc pass on claim-handle.md.
